correctness.rationale: Necessity comes from three-edge-path corner forcing; sufficiency assigns factor sets to endpoints of positive star-forest edges. The bipartite-component exponential formula counts unique labeled components, and the VC maximum follows from forest edge count with a disjoint two-star witness. The Littlestone hypothesis-count upper bound is strict below 2^(p+q), and induction constructs both depth-(p+q-2) branches after querying cell (1,1). Base p=q=1, p=1 negative branch and all empty traces checked. The standalone checker independently enumerated all 74,954 supports for grids up to 4x4 and ten exact minimax online ranks.

value.rationale: The natural unrestricted rank-one Boolean rectangle class has a complete support-by-support graph shattering criterion, which yields all two-sort polynomial coefficients, a closed two-row formula, and exact VC and online dimensions. This separates induced-path partition theorems from trace shattering and gives a sharp one-unit static/online learning gap for every nondegenerate two-factor grid. The statement is not a renaming of a generic counting bound.
